# Shiver Framework

> ESM Discord framework for Node 22.12+ and discord.js 14.28. One definition supports slash and prefix commands.

- [Agent API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuwxbt/shiver-framework/main/AGENTS.md)
